raw_segments.text: "'As far as I am concerned, you may all go to hell, but from what I see, it's clear
to me that I can't make head or tail of it. Please don't think I've come to ask
you questions. I don't want to know, hang it. If you begin telling me your secrets,
I dare say I shouldn't stay to listen. I should go away cursing. I have only come to
find out once for all whether it's a fact that you are mad. There is a conviction in
the air that you are mad or very nearly so.
I admit I've been disposed to that opinion myself, judging from your stupid, repulsive
and quite inexplicable actions and from your recent behavior to your mother and sister.
Only a monster or a madman could treat them as you have, so you must be mad.'"
